title: apiworker.service can't hold its full connection pool -- 'Too many open files'
description_md:
The `apiworker` service is healthy and restarting fine, but it never reaches its expected steady-state connection pool of 40 simultaneous connections. Its journal is full of `Too many open files` errors that repeat forever. Nobody touched the app itself recently -- the only recent change was a systemd unit edit as part of a resource-limits hardening pass. SSH in as `trainee` (passwordless `sudo`), find the real ceiling `apiworker` is hitting, and raise it to something the service actually needs.

You're done when `apiworker` is `active` and actually holding its full 40-connection pool open.
